description: Hierarchical offline disposal guidelines and safety instructions for wasteinfoAI supporting 17 canonical waste categories, specific item identities, and India Solid Waste Management Rules 2016.

rules.disposal_method: Domestic Hazardous Waste / Authorized E-Waste Center
rules.preparation_instructions: Tape the electrical terminals with non-conductive tape to prevent short circuits. Store in a dry plastic container.
rules.safety_warnings: Extreme fire and chemical burn hazard. Never place in standard trash or blue/green recycling bins. Do not puncture or expose to heat.
rules.source: India Solid Waste Management Rules 2016 & E-Waste Management Rules 2022

rules.disposal_method: Authorized E-Waste Collection Center or Take-Back Depot
rules.preparation_instructions: Immediately insulate positive and negative terminals with electrical tape. Store inside a fireproof container or sand bucket if swollen.
rules.safety_warnings: CRITICAL FIRE HAZARD: Thermal runaway risk. Puncturing, crushing, or moisture exposure can spark fierce chemical fires emitting toxic hydrogen fluoride gas.

rules.disposal_method: Domestic Hazardous Waste Collection (Red Bin)
rules.preparation_instructions: Cover 9V terminals with tape. Keep spent batteries dry in a plastic container until collection day.
rules.safety_warnings: Contains potassium hydroxide which may leak and cause chemical skin burns. Wash hands immediately if fluid contacts skin.

rules.disposal_method: Dry Recyclable Waste (Blue Bin) / Kabadiwala Paper Recycler
rules.preparation_instructions: Flatten all cardboard boxes completely. Remove plastic packaging, bubble wrap, and adhesive tape. Keep dry.
rules.safety_warnings: Wet or oily cardboard contaminates paper recycling batches and cannot be pulped.

rules.disposal_method: Compost (Clean portions) or Domestic Non-Recyclable Waste (Black Bin)
rules.preparation_instructions: Tear off and discard greasy/cheesy bottom sections into general waste. The clean top lid can be separated into blue dry recyclables.
rules.safety_warnings: Grease and food oil cannot be washed out during paper re-pulping and causes entire recycling batches to be discarded.

rules.disposal_method: Dry Recyclables (Blue Bin) / Dedicated Beverage Carton Collection
rules.preparation_instructions: Cut open or fold flat, rinse out milk/juice residue thoroughly, and push the attached straw inside the flattened carton.
rules.safety_warnings: Unrinsed liquid cartons develop mold and foul odors rapidly in hot weather.
rules.source: Tetra Pak India Recycling Initiative & SWM 2016

rules.disposal_method: Dry Recyclables Collection (Blue Bin) / Kabadiwala Bottle Recycler
rules.preparation_instructions: Empty and rinse bottles and jars thoroughly. Remove metal or plastic crown caps. Keep intact bottles upright.
rules.safety_warnings: Laceration hazard. Handle carefully to prevent breakage. Do not mix lightbulbs, window glass, mirrors, or ceramics with container glass.

rules.disposal_method: Domestic Hazardous / Wrapped Sharp Waste (Red Bin)
rules.preparation_instructions: Wrap glass shards securely in thick newspaper, cardboard, or place in a rigid cardboard box taped shut, clearly labeled 'CAUTION: BROKEN GLASS'.
rules.safety_warnings: SEVERE LACERATION HAZARD: Waste collection sanitation workers suffer high injury rates from loose glass shards in plastic bags.
rules.source: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) Safety Protocol

rules.disposal_method: Authorized E-Waste Collection Point / Recycler
rules.preparation_instructions: Remove any rechargeable or AA/AAA batteries. Coil cable securely.
rules.safety_warnings: Contains mixed plastics and electronic circuitry. Under E-Waste Rules 2022, must not be handed to informal burning aggregators.

rules.disposal_method: Dry Recyclable Waste (Blue Bin) / Scrap Merchant (Kabadiwala)
rules.preparation_instructions: Rinse food and beverage cans thoroughly. If lids are detached, push them inside the can or crimp the top closed.
rules.safety_warnings: Cut hazard from sharp can edges and lids. Pressurized aerosol cans must never be crushed manually.

rules.disposal_method: Dry Recyclable Waste (Blue Bin) / Kabadiwala
rules.preparation_instructions: Empty all liquid contents completely. Rinse lightly. You may gently crush vertically to save storage space.
rules.safety_warnings: Aluminum saves 95% energy when recycled versus virgin ore bauxite mining. Highly valued scrap.

rules.disposal_method: Domestic Hazardous Waste (Red Bin)
rules.preparation_instructions: Discharge residual gas outdoors in well-ventilated area until empty. Do not puncture or remove valve nozzle.
rules.safety_warnings: EXPLOSION & FIRE HAZARD: Pressurized canisters containing flammable hydrocarbon propellants can explode violently in garbage trucks or incinerators.
rules.source: Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation (PESO) & SWM 2016

rules.disposal_method: Authorized E-Waste Collection Center
rules.preparation_instructions: Unplug appliance. Remove glass turntable and wrap in cardboard. Tape microwave door shut securely during transport.
rules.safety_warnings: LETHAL HIGH VOLTAGE: High-voltage magnetron capacitors can retain fatal electrical charges even years after being unplugged. Never attempt disassembly.

rules.disposal_method: Authorized E-Waste Drop-Off Center / Retailer Take-Back
rules.preparation_instructions: Back up personal data, remove SIM and SD cards, perform factory reset. Ensure phone battery is not punctured.
rules.safety_warnings: Contains lithium-ion battery and precious heavy metals (gold, palladium, lead). Never crush, burn, or discard with household refuse.

rules.disposal_method: E-Waste Collection Facility
rules.preparation_instructions: Remove AA/AAA batteries if wireless. Coil cable securely if wired.
rules.safety_warnings: Contains recyclable electronics and ABS plastics. Hand over to formal e-waste collection channels.

rules.disposal_method: Wet Waste (Green Bin) / Home Composter / Biogas Plant
rules.preparation_instructions: Segregate food scraps, fruit/vegetable peels, leftover food, tea leaves, and flowers. Remove all plastic packaging, rubber bands, and stickers.
rules.safety_warnings: Do not mix with plastic wrappers, batteries, or sanitary waste. Wet waste is converted into organic compost or biogas.

rules.disposal_method: Dry Recyclable Waste (Blue Bin) / Raddiwala / Kabadiwala
rules.preparation_instructions: Keep paper clean, dry, and flat. Bundle newspapers and magazines. Remove metallic spiral bindings and plastic tape.
rules.safety_warnings: Wet, oily, or wax-coated paper cannot be recycled. Dispose soiled napkins in wet waste or sanitary waste.

rules.disposal_method: Authorized Hazardous E-Waste Dismantler / Refiner
rules.preparation_instructions: Handle with dry gloves. Place in anti-static bag or wrapped in cardboard. Keep intact without breaking.
rules.safety_warnings: TOXIC HEAVY METALS: Contains lead, cadmium, mercury, and brominated flame retardants. Acid-leaching or burning causes severe toxic air pollution.
accepted_pathways: Authorized Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) Dismantler
rules.source: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) Guidelines & E-Waste Rules 2022

rules.disposal_method: Dry Recyclables Collection (Blue Bin) / Plastic Scrap Merchant
rules.preparation_instructions: Empty all contents completely. Rinse food/oil residues with a small amount of water. Crush or flatten to save volume.
rules.safety_warnings: Ensure plastics are separated by resin code when possible. Never burn plastic waste; releases toxic dioxins and furans.

rules.disposal_method: Dry Recyclable Waste (Blue Bin) / Kabadiwala / Reverse Vending Machine
rules.preparation_instructions: Empty liquid. Rinse bottle. Squash the bottle flat to reduce bulk, then re-screw the cap loosely so it stays attached for sorting.
rules.safety_warnings: High-grade recyclable polymer converted into polyester fiber and food-grade rPET. Keep uncontaminated with dirt or oil.

rules.disposal_method: Dry Recyclable Waste (Blue Bin) / Plastic Recycler
rules.preparation_instructions: Rinse shampoo, detergent, or milk residue thoroughly. Leave cap on or place inside the container.
rules.safety_warnings: Highly durable and widely recycled into pipes, crates, and bins.

rules.disposal_method: Dry Waste Segregation (Blue Bin) / Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Collection
rules.preparation_instructions: Shake out all food crumbs and dry residue. Bundle multiple pouches together inside one larger plastic pouch.
rules.safety_warnings: Multi-layer metallized laminates cannot be mechanically recycled into clear plastic; routed for co-processing in cement kilns or waste-to-energy.
rules.source: CPCB EPR Guidelines for Plastic Packaging 2022

rules.disposal_method: Authorized E-Waste Collection Point
rules.preparation_instructions: Remove CDs, DVDs, and remote control batteries. Disconnect audio/video cables.
rules.safety_warnings: Recyclable transformer copper and steel casing. Dispose via certified e-waste aggregators.

rules.disposal_method: Authorized E-Waste Depot / Office Equipment Drop-Off
rules.preparation_instructions: Remove ink cartridges and toner bottles separately for specialized recycling. Secure the scanner glass lid.
rules.safety_warnings: Toner powder inhalation hazard. Toner dust contains ultra-fine carbon black and plastic polymers causing respiratory harm if spilled.

rules.disposal_method: Authorized E-Waste Dismantling Facility
rules.preparation_instructions: Keep display panel intact without cracking. Tape screen surface with protective cardboard during transport.
rules.safety_warnings: Explosion/implosion risk and toxic chemical hazard (mercury cold-cathode backlights, lead glass in CRT monitors). Never smash display.

rules.disposal_method: Non-Recyclable Residual Municipal Waste (Black Bin) / Sanitary Waste (Red Bin)
rules.preparation_instructions: Place items in a durable garbage bag. Ensure no recyclables (plastic, paper, metal, dry glass) or wet organics are mixed in.
rules.safety_warnings: Never place lithium batteries, electronics, chemicals, or un-wrapped glass into general trash.

rules.disposal_method: Authorized Bulky E-Waste Facility / Appliance Brand Take-Back
rules.preparation_instructions: Unplug electrical power cord and water inlet hoses. Drain residual water from lint filter. Tape door shut during transport.
rules.safety_warnings: Heavy lifting injury and child entrapment hazard. Remove door latch or door if storing prior to collection.
